title.narrative: Number of persons benefitting from EUfunded programmes to counter sexual and genderbased violence

description.narrative: The indicator measures the participation of SGBV Survivors in Sexual Gender Based Violence Support Groups, in project districts. The threemonth long program will be a space where victims and survivors receive group counselling, offer peer support, learn about their rights, and gain business and trade skills to enable their financial independence and successful reintegration into society. WIN will utilize the WIN FOR HER enterprise, which produces highvalue recycled paper products for sale to local businesses, to include women graduates from the support groups in paid employment. By participating in these activities, clients will increase their selfconfidence, resilience, agency, and independence.
